description: Informatica PowerCenter (on-prem) workflows as Dagster assets. Discovers via `pmrep listobjects`, triggers via `pmcmd startworkflow`, polls via `pmcmd getworkflowdetails`. Full workspace shape: selector + translator + state-backed + polling sensor + freshness check + workflow_overrides (paramfile / -parameter).

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per PowerCenter workflow discovered via `pmrep listobjects`. With `action: noop` (default) each asset is declare-only. With `action: execute` each materialization shells out to `pmcmd startworkflow` (with `workflow_overrides` applied as `-paramfile` / `-parameter NAME=VALUE`) and polls `pmcmd getworkflowdetails` to a terminal status (Succeeded / Failed / Aborted / Stopped / Terminated / Unknown). No inputs — PowerCenter runs its own workflows.

workflow_selector.label: Workflow Selector
workflow_selector.description: Filter which workflows become assets (by_folder / include / exclude fnmatch).

workflow_overrides.label: Workflow Overrides
workflow_overrides.description: Runtime parameter files + variable overrides applied at execute time.

action.label: Action
action.description: noop = external asset; execute = pmcmd startworkflow + poll.

name: Informatica PowerCenter Workspace
